rows.ARS:
Medium red Floribunda.
Exhibition name: Centenaire de Lourdes Rouge ®
rows.Origin:
Bred by G. Delbard (France, 1985).
Introduced in France by Delbard/Georges Delbard SA in 1992 as 'Centenaire de Lourdes Rouge'.
rows.Bloom: Red. Mild to strong fragrance. Medium, double (17-25 petals), cupped bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Bushy. Medium, glossy, medium green foliage.

Height: 31" to 39" (80 to 100cm). Width: 16" to 2' (40 to 60cm).
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
rows.Notes: Internal breeder code: 85-294-25. (Source: Website Roseto Niso Fumagalli.)
